what: Proposed degraded-tools gate fence omits IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR export and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT rehydration before the four read-session-env-key.sh calls
scenario_or_breakage: The plan calls the fence self-contained across fresh Bash tool calls, but read-session-env-key.sh and degraded-tools-gate.sh both need CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and session-env.sh needs IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR; a literal paste of the four reads plus gate invocation fails or re-triggers PRESENCE_INPUT_EMPTY
suggested_fix: Prepend the same two-line guard used in adjacent implement fences (export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR, source plugin-root.env or awk LARCH_CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT from session-env.sh, export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) before the four reads; optionally pin those tokens in test-implement-structure.sh
